lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I think here is good.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Since there's only one way in?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Precisely, and the entrance is quite wide, which makes it suitable for a campsite.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I'll go deploy the decoys then.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: You know how to do that?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Of course. I may not have been up to the surface as much as you, but I'm not completely unfamiliar with it.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Also, my role is to trace the best route for us, so I'm good at picking the best spots to set up the decoys.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: All right, then. I appreciate you doing this.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I'm just doing my job. You don't have to make it sound like I'm going out of my way.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Let's go together.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I'll be fine. You should rest.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It's okay. It'll go by quicker if we work together. Then we can rest.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Shall we?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Okay.
Liveryn and Anis move out.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Um... Are we sleeping here?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hmm...
Are you particular about where you sleep?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Yes, but that's not what I'm worried about.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: You never know when or where those crystals might target us.

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: There aren't any nearby.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: Positive.

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: As long as you don't go to sleep hugging them, you'll be just fine.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Okay...

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: Are you always this on edge?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Naturally.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: It's the best way to increase your chance of survival and success. Exercise caution, and strike at the opportune moment.

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: Zzzzzzz...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hehe, I also noticed that you fall asleep in no time flat,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: and you snore like a jet engine.
Will that affect your sleep?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: It won't be an issue.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I wasn't planning on sleeping, anyway.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Getting some sleep would be a good idea.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: It's okay. I got plenty of sleep before coming here. I'll keep watch so you all can catch up on your shuteye.
Elegg,
are you unable to sleep because you're too amped up?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hehe,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: it's that obvious, huh?
I noticed how excited you were after seeing the crystal,
and you seemed much more expressive than when I first saw you.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: It's an incredible thrill to finally lay my own eyes on something

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I was told about endlessly during the mission briefing.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Do you think I'm getting too emotional about all this?
No. I like it.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Huh? So that means... you like me?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Typical Master. Just blurting out whatever he feels.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: We'll take turns keeping watch. I'll go up first.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Should you find yourself unable to sleep, we'll keep watch together.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: You don't mind?
Shifty.

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: Yes, Commander?
How is Reclamation Site 01 doing?

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: All quiet.

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: Surprisingly so.

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: I didn't expect the optical camouflage to be this effective.
Then take a break.

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: I was about to enter standby mode anyway.

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: We'll be monitoring Reclamation Site 01 in alternating shifts, so don't worry.
Sounds good. You did well today.

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: As did you, Commander.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Mr. Commander, may I see that?
See what?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The operation device.
I take my operation device out from my ear and hand it to Elegg.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: How long have you been using this?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: When was the last time it was maintained?
Um... I can't recall.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: It's on its last legs. The connections are about to fall apart, and the parts are all worn out.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Would you mind if I make a few repairs?
By all means.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Just a moment.
*Click click*

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: Zzzzzzz...
*Click click*

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: Zzzzzz...
For a while, only the sounds of Hammering snoring and Elegg tinkering with my operation device can be heard.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Finished.
Than...
Huh?
The status panel on my operation device has been altered.
There appears to be something moving on the screen...
I lean in to get a closer look.
Is this... a video game?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Ha, I didn't think I'd get found out that quickly, but you've got some eagle eyes on you.
What is it?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: This is BOOM, a classic FPS. It's the father of all modern FPS games.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The entire file size is only 28 megabytes, but it's still more fun than most of the games out there today.
But why... how did you...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: If it's got a screen, you can run BOOM on it. It's just common sense.
I'm not so sure about that...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Well, it's the truth, so don't you forget it.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: By the way, this is more than just a title screen. You can actually play the full game.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Although you don't have a controller... I'll make one right now.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Let's see... gotta get some spare parts...
It's okay. I'll play it later.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Are you sure? It's really fun...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I also installed it on Ms. Rapi's weapon adjustment correction screen.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... What?
Rapi checks her gun.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hehe, not bad, eh? Like I said, if it's got a screen, I can install that game.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Please erase it.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Oh, some delivery requests just came in.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I was dealing with the customers.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You sure are busy.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Just trying to survive. I'm just happy I've got work.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How often do you have to work?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: It depends. We usually tend to get pretty bogged down during the holidays.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: But other than that, it's scattershot.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Must be tough. Are you done dealing with your customers?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Then let's head back. We should get some sleep so that we're well-rested tomorrow.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: There's just one thing.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: As far as I know, there aren't any holidays coming up anytime soon.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: And yet you're still so busy?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: ... Well, like I said, it can be pretty random.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Guess I got lucky.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Really? Glad to hear it.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Hehe, yeah,

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: me too.
The next day.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Gah!!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Neon!!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: W-what is this? My eyes are acting strange!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Some kind of game is taking up my vision!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: There's a game screen on your glass lenses...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: BOOM? Why is that ancient game...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Is this some kind of cutting-edge VR technology? The graphics look a bit outdated for that, though...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Elegg.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hehe, I upgraded your glasses while you were sleeping.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I've given you the honor of being able to play a masterpiece of gaming up close and personal.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I don't want a game. I want super vision! I want... Vision Eye!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: ... You should really reconsider that name...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Actually, I meant to ask you:

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Where did you get those glasses, anyway?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: These? I've had them for as long as I can remember.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: They're extraordinary.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The frames are made of cutting-edge and lightweight materials.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The lenses are in fact a high-performance visual display. I've never seen anything like it.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The internal OS has a ludicrously large capacity, and it's being utilized to the max.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: There was barely enough space left to install BOOM.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I have no idea what you're going on about, but can you just get rid of this game and bring my glasses back to normal?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Just tap the top of your frames twice, and it'll shut off.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Can you make it so that I can tap the sides? It'll look way cooler that way.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I'm telling you, you should look into that eyewear of yours.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: They're no ordinary pair of glasses.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: What's that on the wall over there?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Gaaaaah!

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: O-over there!
I look in the direction Elegg is pointing.
Over on the walls which have been to our back and sides,
densely packed clusters of tiny crystals have formed.
None of those were there last night.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Could they have moved over here?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Don't be absurd! Crystals don't have legs.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Maybe they have detachable legs?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: At this point, I don't think that's totally outside the realm of possibility.

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: Maybe the crystal formations were already here,

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: and they've only just now popped out since we were here for a while.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: You mean they move in order to consume nutrients?

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: I've been thinking,

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: and these things seem less and less like a type of ore.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: What are they, then?

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: Don't they seem more plant-like to you?

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: It has roots, dies as soon as it runs out of nutrients, and actively moves towards acquiring said nutrients.

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: If that doesn't describe a plant-based lifeform to a T, what does?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: It all checks out.

lines.speaker: hammering
lines.text: Just as a precaution, I'll contact the Botanic Garden squad. I'm on good terms with them.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: That sounds like a good idea.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Commander, how should we proceed?
Let's keep going. If we sense any danger, we'll head back.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Roger.
